3. FINITE-TIME STABILITY ANALYSIS
In this section we will analyze the finite-time stability for IQVIPs (1.1). By doing so we pro-
pose a new first order dynamical system associated with the problem (1.1) such that a solution
of (1.1) becomes an equilibrium point of the dynamical system. Under mild conditions for the
parameters, we demonstrate that the proposed dynamical system is finite-time stable.
We first recall a characterization for the finite-time stability of solutions of a dynamical sys-
tem, given by Bhat and Bernstein in [5]. This result will play an important role in studying
finite-time convergence.
